header.title: About Me
header.description: Software Engineering graduate specialized in Cybersecurity (U-TAD, GPA 8.3/10) and OSCP certified (Offensive Security Certified Professional). Currently working as a Security Architecture Analyst at Deloitte. Focused on offensive and defensive operations, infrastructure hardening, and security automation across Windows, Linux, Active Directory, and Cloud. Additionally, I was a high-performance alpine skier—a background that instilled discipline, resilience, and composure under sustained pressure.

softSkills: Ability to thrive under sustained pressure

header.title: Defensive and offensive strategies

Specialized in Active Directory attack chains, Linux and Windows environments, security automation, and threat detection with SIEM (Wazuh).
